name: Question 2
problem:
Find ${f}^{″}(\frac{1}{2},\frac{1}{2})$ for the function $f(x,y)$ given that
${f}^{′}(x,y)=[\begin{aligned}10xy & 5{x}^{2}-2y\end{aligned}]$
worked_solution:
For a function $f:{R}^{n}\to R,$ given by

$$
f:{{[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2} \\ ⋮ \\ {x}_{n}\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{x}⟶f({x}_{1},{x}_{2},…,{x}_{n}),
$$

the second derivative of $f$ is given by the $n\times n$ matrix

$$
{f}^{″}(x)=[\begin{aligned}\frac{{∂}^{2}f}{∂{x}_{1}^{2}} & \frac{{∂}^{2}f}{∂{x}_{1}∂{x}_{2}} & ⋯ & \frac{{∂}^{2}f}{∂{x}_{1}∂{x}_{n}} \\ \frac{{∂}^{2}f}{∂{x}_{2}∂{x}_{1}} & \frac{{∂}^{2}f}{∂{x}_{2}^{2}} & ⋯ & \frac{{∂}^{2}f}{∂{x}_{2}∂{x}_{n}} \\ ⋮ & ⋮ & ⋮ & ⋮ \\ \frac{{∂}^{2}f}{∂{x}_{n}∂{x}_{1}} & \frac{{∂}^{2}f}{∂{x}_{n}∂{x}_{2}} & ⋯ & \frac{{∂}^{2}f}{∂{x}_{n}^{2}}\end{aligned}].
$$

In our case, we have

$$
{f}^{″}(x,y)=[\begin{aligned}\frac{{∂}^{2}f}{∂{x}^{2}} & \frac{{∂}^{2}f}{∂x∂y} \\ \frac{{∂}^{2}f}{∂y∂x} & \frac{{∂}^{2}f}{∂{y}^{2}}\end{aligned}].
$$

First, notice that since ${f}^{′}(x,y)=[\begin{aligned}10xy & 5{x}^{2}-2y\end{aligned}],$ 
 we must have

$$
\frac{∂f}{∂x}=10xy,\,\frac{∂f}{∂y}=5{x}^{2}-2y.
$$

Now, we compute the second partial derivatives:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{{∂}^{2}f}{∂{x}^{2}} & =\frac{∂}{∂x}(10xy)=10y\, & \frac{{∂}^{2}f}{∂x∂y} & =\frac{∂}{∂x}(5{x}^{2}-2y)=10x \\ \frac{{∂}^{2}f}{∂y∂x} & =\frac{∂}{∂y}(10xy)=10x\, & \frac{{∂}^{2}f}{∂{y}^{2}} & =\frac{∂}{∂y}(5{x}^{2}-2y)=-2\end{aligned}
$$

So, the second derivative is

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{″}(x,y) & =[\begin{aligned}10y & 10x \\ 10x & -2\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we evaluate this matrix at $(\frac{1}{2},\frac{1}{2}).$ This gives

$$
{f}^{″}(\frac{1}{2},\frac{1}{2})=[\begin{aligned}5 & 5 \\ 5 & -2\end{aligned}].
$$

Question 2
?

Find f″(12,12) for the function f(x,y) given that f′(x,y)=[10xy5x2−2y]

a
[52020−2]
b
[1055−2]
c
[20−5−5−2]
d
[51010−2]
e
[555−2]
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

For a function f:Rn→R, given by f:[x1x2⋮xn]⏟x⟶f(x1,x2,…,xn),

the second derivative of f is given by the n×n matrix

f″(x)=[∂2f∂x12∂2f∂x1∂x2⋯∂2f∂x1∂xn∂2f∂x2∂x1∂2f∂x22⋯∂2f∂x2∂xn⋮⋮⋮⋮∂2f∂xn∂x1∂2f∂xn∂x2⋯∂2f∂xn2].

In our case, we have

f″(x,y)=[∂2f∂x2∂2f∂x∂y∂2f∂y∂x∂2f∂y2].

First, notice that since f′(x,y)=[10xy5x2−2y], we must have

∂f∂x=10xy,∂f∂y=5x2−2y.

Now, we compute the second partial derivatives:

∂2f∂x2=∂∂x(10xy)=10y∂2f∂x∂y=∂∂x(5x2−2y)=10x∂2f∂y∂x=∂∂y(10xy)=10x∂2f∂y2=∂∂y(5x2−2y)=−2

So, the second derivative is

f″(x,y)=[10y10x10x−2].

Finally, we evaluate this matrix at (12,12). This gives

f″(12,12)=[555−2].
